title: Layer Organization, Masks & Clipping Paths
subtitle: Layer Hierarchy, Vector Clipping, Vector Masking, Blend Modes & Isolation Mode
description: Master enterprise-scale vector organization: complex layer nesting, the critical mechanical distinction between Vector Clipping (child nesting) and Vector Masking (thumbnail drop), advanced Blend Ranges, and distraction-free Isolation Mode.
prerequisites: D02: Vector Nodes, Paths & Pen Tool Geometry
D03: Advanced Shape Creation & Boolean Geometry
learningOutcomes: Structure professional scene graphs using Groups, Layer Containers, Locks, and Color Tags.
Distinguish mechanically between Vector Clipping (child nesting) and Vector Masking (thumbnail docking).
Employ the 'Insert Inside the Selection' workflow (Ctrl+Alt+X / Cmd+Opt+X) for rapid contained drafting.
Manipulate layer Blend Modes and fine-tune tonal transition curves in the Blend Ranges dialog.
Engage and exit Isolation Mode (Alt+Click / Option+Click on layer thumbnail) for distraction-free editing.

capstoneProject.title: Layered Fantasy Isometric Citadel
capstoneProject.description: Construct an intricate multi-tier fantasy tower featuring nested vector clipping masks for stone textures, masked shadow cast planes, and color-tagged layer groups with Blend Ranges.
evaluationCriteria: Scene graph organized into color-tagged and named groups.
Vector clipping masks used cleanly without raster flattening.
Blend mode shadows interact dynamically with underlying architecture.
